573-2645-3430-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
573-2645-3430-4644.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2577-3899-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-3899-6664-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3240-4247-5477-6462.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-6719.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

5508-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

3861-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

4-1170-1636-7417.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Wild Idea using convoke without paying mana.
4-1170-1636-7417.description:
Cast Wild Idea using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sanar, Unfinished Genius.
When Sanar, Unfinished Genius enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

requires.n: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

3525-7786--140.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding {U}.
Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.
3525-7786--140.notes: The chosen mana-producing creature must produce at least {U}.

3375-4399-4506-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4506-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2685-3197-3263-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-3263-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4377-4428-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Thassa.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
1879-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
1879-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6441-6791.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-3499-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1636-5803-6786-7028.description:
Activate Kitsa by tapping it, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures twice.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
392-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

851-1563-2457-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4336-5220-5686-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

149-4474-4831.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

411-2440-3263.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {3}.
When Grinning Ignus enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {1} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

2061-2104-2187.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-2187.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2281-2438-5756.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

45-1987-2510-2556.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
45-1987-2510-2556.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
